obernants.approximation_semantics: Mathematical relation; finite correspondence evidence only
obernants.assumptions: Successful standard allocations, terminating single-threaded calls
obernants.domain: Declared bounded API inputs, states and finite fixtures
obernants.observation_scope: Exact values, index order, state transitions and named assertions
obernants.operator: A state/output transition is excluded when its key set differs from set insertion/removal semantics, a duplicate changes its stored priority, an absent removal changes shape, or BST/heap/parent invariants fail. Returning Ok(true) for existing keys or accepting a new key at4096 live keys is excluded. This constrains state, not only a returned boolean.

obernants.operator: Observed keys admit many insertion/removal histories and explicit priority assignments; the full live (key,priority) map determines a unique Cartesian tree under total rank order but not free-slot indexes or history. Ok(false) insertion reconstructs prior presence, not the previous priority. A removed key's priority cannot be recovered from its success boolean.

obernants.operator: Heap rank is total lexicographic (u64 priority,i64 key); equal priorities order by key. Duplicate insertion does not replace priority. Determinism needs no RNG and supplies no probabilistic balancing guarantee.

obernants.operator: A rotation moves middle subtree under former parent, updates middle parent, grandparent edge and root as needed. Inorder keys and external subtrees are conserved; heap violations are resolved during insertion/deletion.

obernants.operator: Deletion first removes all live links to target before adding its slot to free. A subsequent insertion overwrites the slot completely. live_count=nodes.len-free.len; resident arena never exceeds4096 slots despite repeated churn.
